verdict.rationale: Opting out of tracking is a fair question for an analytics/tracking product, but the evidence pack never documents an opt-out mechanism for telemetry or usage tracking. The closest items are GDPR deletion/retrieval APIs, EU data residency and Session Replay sampling controls. These are adjacent privacy features, not a user-facing or SDK-level opt-out of tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
